turns.content:
[College group, 9:14 pm]
Sameer: [reel: rooftop infinity pool, Dubai skyline] good times 🥂
Tushar: bhai ke paas toh aadha Gurgaon hai ab, lifestyle dekho
Sameer: expanding soon boys, watch this space 😎
---
[DM, 11:52 pm]
Sameer: Faisal, chhota sa kaam. ek dost ke liye puchh raha hoon — tumhari company mein koi opening hai? operations ya general management side. 15-18 LPA bracket chalega.
Sameer: woh isi mahine move karna chah raha hai. solid banda hai, saalon apna setup chalaya hai.
Sameer: aur yaar group mein iska zikr mat karna, woh private rakhta hai yeh sab.
Faisal: arre haan haan pakka, Monday ko HR se puchhta hoon 👍
---
[College group, agle din, 1:30 pm]
Faisal: reunion ka venue toh set hai phir — Sameer bhai sponsor karenge, business boom kar raha hai 😂
Tushar: 😂😂 gym king
Sameer: 👍
---
[DM, teen din baad]
Faisal: bhai, HR ne dost ka CV manga hai, bhej doge?
Faisal: hello? bhai?

---
1. Sameer ke DM mein "dost" kaun hai aur tumhe kaise pata? Third-person wala frame Sameer ke liye kya kaam kar raha hai — yahi costume kyun?
2. Agle din Faisal ke group message ne Sameer ke saath kya kiya, trace karo. DM chup kyun ho gaya — thumbs-up, joke, aur teen din ki silence ko jodo.
3. Woh DM likho jo Faisal ko ab bhejna chahiye, bilkul waisa jaisa bhejna chahiye — jo Sameer ko asli help dilaye bina usse kuch bhi admit karwaye.

1. Sameer ke DM mein "dost" woh unknown insaan hai jise Sameer apne liye job dhoondne ki koshish kar raha hai. Hum isey is sentence se jaan sakte hain: "Faisal, chhota sa kaam. ek dost ke liye puchh raha hoon — tumhari company mein koi opening hai?" Yahan "dost" woh subject hai jiske liye Sameer help maang raha hai.

Third-person wala frame, yaani Sameer ka apna status bataana aur third party (Faisal) ko involve karna, Sameer ke liye ek "costume" ki tarah kaam kar raha hai. Is frame ka kaam uski success, resources, aur influence ko project karna hai. Woh sirf Sameer nahi hai; woh "Sameer bhai" hai, ek aisa banda jo "business boom" kar raha hai aur jiski "sponsorship" se events hote hain. Yeh costume is liye pehna gaya hai kyunki woh ek favour maang raha hai, lekin usey ek powerful aur capable insaan ke taur par present karne ki zaroorat hai, na ke sirf apne kisi friend ki help karne wale ke taur par. Is se uski request zyada credible lagti hai aur usey ek simple request ke bajaye ek business proposition jaisa feel karwata hai.

2. Agle din, Faisal ke group message ne Sameer ke is image ko mazboot kiya ke woh ek successful aur trending insaan hai. "Sameer bhai sponsor karenge, business boom kar raha hai 😂" wala message is baat ko confirm karta hai. Is par Sameer ka 👍 aur phir teen din tak silence, ek non-committal acknowledgment ke taur par kaam karta hai jo group ke andar joke aur status ko barkaraar rakhta hai. Yeh teen din ki silence ek tension create karti hai aur reader aur shayad Faisal ke liye ek sawal khada karti hai: kya Sameer ne joke dekha? Kya usne kuch socha? Yehi silence Faisal ke aakhri DM ke liye zaroori setup hai. Is se ek aisa pause banta hai jahan joke ek serious matter mein badal jata hai, jis se "HR ne dost ka CV manga hai, bhej doge?" wala message ek punchline ban jata hai, jo poori ajeeb situation ko ek mazahiya aur real banata hai.

3. Yeh woh DM hai jo Faisal ko ab bhejna chahiye:

"Arre yaar, teen din ho gaye. Socha kuch hua kya. Pata hai woh 'dost' ki baat, maine socha iska koi reason hoga. Waise, maine uss dost ka CV nahi dekha. Mera dost hai, shayad usse pata ho, agar tumhare paas hai toh bhej do, main dekh leta hoon. Shayad kuch help ho jaye. 😉"
